name: codebreaker
tagline: A vulnerability benchmark across modern CVE classes, plus an agent harness and loop that patch what the agents find.
problem: Software supply-chain attacks are rising, the team says, and existing AI security benchmarks cover mostly memory-safety bugs in C/C++.
solution: ECVE-Bench draws cases from the GitHub Advisory Database across the CWE Top 25; an agent harness runs models against it in sandboxes and an autonomous loop validates and patches findings through GitHub workflows.
demo_moment: Team-described: a leaderboard of models on the benchmark and an agent run that finds and patches a vulnerability.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “1st Overall” and “Cognition Company Challenge” among 307 submissions.
Pairs a broader benchmark with an agent that acts on its own findings.
A measured leaderboard backs the claim, which fits the Technical Depth criterion.

lessons: Ship the benchmark with the agent: a measured result makes an agent claim credible.
